components.name: Button
components.description: Interactive element for user actions.
components.usage: Combine .nz-button with .nz-button-primary or .nz-button-secondary. Use disabled to prevent actions, aria-busy="true" with a visible progress label for loading.

components.name: Panel
components.description: Container for grouping related content.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact status or information indicator.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Small label for categorizing content.

components.name: Form Panel
components.description: Scoped form styling with a theme-aware chevron and a progressively styled native select picker.
components.usage: Use .nz-form-panel; associate labels using for/id. Add .nz-field-label for grouped labels, and .nz-form-panel-compact for short fields. For errors set aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby to a .nz-field-error element.

components.name: Navigation List
components.description: Vertical list of links with hover and current-page styling.
components.usage: Use .nz-nav-list with semantic navigation markup and aria-current="page" for the current page.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Framework-independent SVG icons from a curated Lucide sprite.
components.usage: Reference a symbol with <svg class="nz-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/assets/nicolabz/icons.svg#search"></use></svg>. Give meaningful standalone icons an accessible name.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline contextual messages with explicit status text.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Native modal dialog.
components.usage: Use a .nz-dialog-actions container for right-aligned, wrapping actions, including inside .nz-form-panel.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Stacked, dismissible viewport notification in a live region.
components.usage: Place a focusable live region directly under body. Call showToast(region, message, { variant, duration, dismissLabel }); variant is info, success, warning or error. Add .nz-toast-region-bottom for bottom placement.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Native checkbox presented as a switch.

components.name: Field Label
components.description: Block label with spacing for a form field.

components.name: Choice
components.description: Aligned label and native checkbox or radio control.

components.name: Control Row
components.description: Wrapping row for related controls.

components.name: Loading Label
components.description: Aligned loading indicator and text.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Native radio input.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate loading indicator.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Placeholder for content being loaded.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Compact labeled action using an icon.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Keyboard-accessible tabbed content.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Expandable content based on native details.

components.name: Table
components.description: Structured data with horizontal overflow on small screens.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Navigation links for pages of results.

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: Native disclosure for contextual links and actions.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Contextual non-interactive description.
